description: This file contains JavaScript functions and code related to rendering user and organization options, as well as filtering user and organization data based on DOM elements and specific criteria.

methods.name: renderUserOrgOption
methods.description: Generates a display string and name for a user or organization based on provided data.

methods.name: filterUserOrg
methods.description: Filters out users and organizations from data based on DOM element lists and sorts the remaining data by display name.
